description: Liquidations on Hyperliquid over a trailing window, totalled across every market or the ones named: count, wallets, notional, longs vs shorts liquidated, the top markets and the largest single liquidation with its price. Use it for 'who got liquidated in the last hour?' or 'how much was liquidated today?'. For the individual liquidations use get_liquidations; for liquidations grouped by price use get_liquidation_levels; for where open positions would be liquidated next use get_liquidation_map. Windows from 15m to 24h without a key, 7d with one. Totals are computed by the API over every liquidation, not sampled.

market.description: Optional: one market or a comma list (BTC-PERP,ETH-PERP); Hyperliquid names work (BTC, xyz:NVDA)

minutes.description: Older form of window, rounded up to the next one (90 becomes 4h)

name: get_liquidation_summary

complete.description: Always true: totals cover every liquidation in the window

largest.description: Largest single liquidation, or null when there were none

longs_liquidated_usd.description: Notional of liquidated longs in USD

market.description: Market filter, or null for all markets

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

shorts_liquidated_usd.description: Notional of liquidated shorts in USD

title: Liquidation summary
